title: Entangling Ions with Engineered Light Gradients
summary: A high-fidelity two-qubit entangling gate based on engineered light gradients in a trapped-ion chain.

summary: Photon loss in optical channels fundamentally limits long-range reliable quantum communication. A standard approach to overcoming this limitation is the use of quantum repeater nodes, which typically perform experimentally demanding non-Gaussian operations. title: Chirality-Resolved Spectroscopy of Caroli–de Gennes–Matricon States in Multiband ${\mathrm{FeTe}}_{1−x}{\mathrm{Se}}_{x}$ Superconductors
summary: Terahertz magneto-optics is established as a direct probe of helical vortex-core excitations, providing dynamical evidence for multiband CdGM states in iron-based superconductors.

title: Toward Complete Characterization of Topological Insulators and Superconductors: A Systematic Construction of Topological Invariants Based on Atiyah-Hirzebruch Spectral Sequence
summary: A framework based on the Atiyah-Hirzebruch spectral sequence in momentum space yields topological invariants that classify stable superconducting phases across 159 space groups.

title: Quantum Advantage for Sensing Properties of Classical Fields
summary: Researchers demonstrate a quantum sensing protocol that uses entanglement and squeezing to learn diverse classical signal properties with subvacuum precision.

title: Nontrivial Boundary-Mediated Superconducting Transport in a TRSB Topological Iron-Based Superconductor
summary: Edge-mediated nonlocal transport measurements in thin devices reveal a robust conductance plateau governed by spontaneous magnetic ordering.

title: Cosmological and High-Energy Physics Implications from Gravitational-Wave Background Searches in LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA’s O1–O4a Runs
summary: Numerous well-motivated particle-physics-based models are constrained using the most recent LIGO-Virgo gravitational-wave data.

title: Electric-Field-Induced X-Ray Nonreciprocal Dichroism in Hematite
summary: X-ray absorption spectroscopy under an applied electric field uncovers signatures of hidden higher-order magnetic multipoles in hematite ( ), supported by theoretical calculations.

title: Topological Phase Transitions and Their Thermodynamic Fate in Arbitrary-$S$ Classical Pyrochlore Spin Ice
summary: A theoretical framework for arbitrary-spin pyrochlore spin ice reveals that = 3/2 magnets alone switch abruptly between two distinct spin-liquid states, a transition that survives the thermal fluctuations that wash all the other transitions into crossovers.

title: Vanishing Phase Stiffness and Fluctuation-Dominated Superconductivity in ${\mathrm{UTe}}_{2}$
summary: Ultrasound measurements in uranium ditelluride ( ) reveal precursor superconducting fluctuations up to twice the critical temperature, providing high kinetic inductance in a clean material.

title: Observation of Wannier-Rydberg and Charge-Transfer Hybrid Moiré Excitons under Pressure
summary: Hydrostatic pressure continuously tunes the moiré potential in semiconductor superlattices, driving a crossover to a strong-moiré regime that hybridizes Wannier-Rydberg and charge-transfer excitons.

title: Quasicrystal Topological Hydrodynamics
summary: Quasicrystalline water waves allow exquisite insight into topological physics and provides a unique platform for manipulating particle for a wide range of applications.

title: Robustness of Real-Space Topology in Moiré Systems
summary: Topological analysis of real-space electronic textures in nonidealized moiré systems establishes a robust band index and maps wave functions onto a texturally derived fictitious magnetic field.

title: Ab Initio Auxiliary-Field Quantum Monte Carlo in the Thermodynamic Limit
summary: A low-scaling auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo method enables accurate simulations of real quantum materials, bridging the gap between benchmark many-body models and complex solid-state systems.

title: Strain-Tunable Anomalous Hall Effect in Hexagonal MnTe
summary: Uniaxial strain applied to the hexagonal altermagnet isolates a single magnetic domain, revealing a sharp anomalous Hall effect and a sign reversal driven by modifications to the electronic Berry curvature.

title: Pseudogap, Fermi Liquid, Van Hove Singularity, and Maxima of the Compressibility and of the Knight Shift as a Function of Doping in the Two-Dimensional Hubbard Model
summary: Analysis of Hubbard model simulations reveals that a maximum in the isothermal compressibility marks the pseudogap boundary, driven by spin-density-wave precursor bands crossing the zero-frequency level.

title: Riemannian Geometric Classification and Emergent Phenomena of Magnetic Textures
summary: A classification framework based on differential geometry introduces geodesic and torsional scalar spin chiralities, revealing a quantum geometric effect that modifies electron equations of motion in complex magnetic textures.

title: High-Dimensional Dynamics in Low-Dimensional Networks
summary: The relationship between the dimensionality of a network’s structure and its dynamics is investigated, showing that networks with low-dimensional structures can produce either high- or low-dimensional responses.
